# Cloverhound

> Cloverhound is a contact center and collaboration technology company specializing in Cisco and Amazon Connect solutions. We offer cloud-based products (Cloverhound Cloud, Connect, Vigilus), professional services, managed services, and software development for enterprise communications.

## Products

- [Cloverhound Cloud](/cloud): Cloud-based contact center platform with analytics, campaign management, operations control, and monitoring modules
- [Cloverhound Connect](/connect): Industry-specific contact center solutions for healthcare and courts
- [Vigilus](/vigilus): Real-time monitoring platform for legacy alarm monitoring, troubleshooting, 24/7 IVR monitoring, and interactive dashboards
- [Cloud Platform](/cloud-platform): Advanced cloud platform with integrations, security, and enterprise capabilities
- [OmniSuite](/omni-suite): Omnichannel suite with OmniBot, OmniConnector for WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and more
- [Collab Suite](/collab-suite): Collaboration Suite featuring Quality Manager with call recording and agent improvement tools
- [Virtual Agents](/virtual-agents): AI-powered virtual agents with Dialogflow integration and NLP capabilities

## Cloud Modules

- [Analytics Module](/cloverhound-cloud/analytics-module): Contact center analytics and reporting
- [Campaign Manager](/cloverhound-cloud/campaign-manager): Outbound campaign management
- [Operations Control Portal](/cloverhound-cloud/operations-control-portal): Real-time operations management
- [Monitoring Module](/cloverhound-cloud/monitoring-module): Infrastructure and service monitoring

## Services

- [Professional Services](/services): Unified communications consulting, implementation, and support
- [Managed Services](/managed-services): Ongoing IT management with people, processes, and products approach
- [API Integration](/api-integration): Custom API integrations and development services
- [Amazon Connect](/amazon-connect): Amazon Connect implementation and migration services

## Partnerships

- [Cisco](/cisco): Cisco certified partner for collaboration and contact center solutions
- [Finesse](/finesse): Cisco Finesse integrations with Salesforce, Zendesk, and ticketing systems

## Industry Solutions

- [Healthcare](/healthcare): Contact center solutions for healthcare organizations
- [Connect for Healthcare](/connect-2/healthcare): Cloverhound Connect tailored for healthcare
- [Connect for Courts](/connect-2/courts): Cloverhound Connect tailored for court systems
